**Round 461 is closed.** I checked C's own files (mutants, test log, protection probe), not just the report, before closing anything. C passed all 10 rows with real browser checks, and gate 461 published `a7fa78e`. A-R460-REVIEW-1, -6 and -7 are closed. The gate reviewer's 3 Lows (GATE461-1..3) went to `deferred_low_polish`, and its note about extracting the entrance test helpers is recorded as a signal only. `tasks/round-461.md` is a byte-identical copy of the old task.

**Why this task and not the planned 2b-3c-2b:**
- No Medium or worse that the loop can fix is open.
- 2b-3c-2b is Low/info only. It would be a fourth round on `style-scan.ts` while the root architecture checkpoint on that file is unanswered. It is moved after 2b-3d-2 (D-29z1631), not dropped.
- 2b-3d is split. Stage 1 (this round) deletes the modules; stage 2 (next) removes the dead CSS rules.

**Round 462 scope:**
- **Deleted:** VideoShowcase, PianoLoadingAnimation, PianoCurtainLoader, CinemaCurtainLoader, audio/Timeline and `email.server.ts`, plus their barrel lines and test allow-list entries. A new test row, GT6, checks they stay deleted. Permission is your 2026-11-10 legacy policy plus the Q6 default, which got no objection.
- **Kept:** TestimonialsSection, IconButton and ChatButton, as before. **ArtistBioSection is now kept too.** It is the only file that shows the "Downloads / Products / 10K+ Happy Producers" stats, and the keep-list protects all stats. Q6 had wrongly told you only Testimonials had keep-list content. This is now question SABA-Q-ARTISTBIO-STATS in `user-review/questions-round-462.md`; the default is to keep it, so the loop does not wait.

**What I checked on the sketch:**
- Typecheck and lint pass, and the full suite passes (284 files, 4182 tests).
- 9 deliberately broken versions of the code all turn the right tests red.
- tech-lead approved both sketch versions.
- **Production builds, HEAD vs sketch:** server and JS are identical once content hashes are ignored. The CSS loses 12 Tailwind utilities that only the deleted files used; no live code uses any of them.
- **In a real browser:** 6 pages (5 Store pages plus `/studio-lab`) at both viewports render identical text on HEAD and the sketch. A HEAD-vs-HEAD control matched, no element carries the removed classes, and no file failed to load.

**For C:** the anonymous `/studio-lab` and purchase-protection checks are rows again. The build compare and the page probe are saved scripts C reruns and compares to my output.

**Next:**
- The regression is due 2026-11-13, so the next planning on or after that date is REGRESSION-2026-11-13. RETRO 465 follows.
- Root should expect 6 deleted tracked files and a slightly smaller CSS bundle when it publishes.

**Not COMPLETE** because 2b-3d-2 through STORE-5, ARCH-SPLIT, REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS, STEM-LANES, T12-ADVANCED, phase 2 and the deferred Lows remain. **Not BLOCKED**: nothing external is needed.
